summary: Land acquisition validity; Section 5A objections hearing inadequacies; notices via Gram Pradhan insufficient; consolidated rejection of objections as formality; corrigendum undermining fairness; Section 6(1) declaration quashed; due process violation for abadi landowners; public purpose development challenged; compensation acceptance not waiver of challenge rights; procedural defects outweigh expenditure incurred.
legal_provisions_cited: Land Acquisition Act, 1894 s.4(1), s.5A, s.6(1)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; acquisition proceedings restored with due process adherence.
